verdict: ROAS dropped sharply this week; spend is being pulled back now.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta ads returned a 4.9 return on ad spend (ROAS) on $1,486.13 in spend, generating $7,278.65 in revenue across 38 purchases. However, the most recent 7 days tell a different story: ROAS fell 63.53% week-over-week while spend climbed 13.96%, and the last three days (Sep 9–11) produced just 3 purchases combined — a clear sign the top campaign is scaling into diminishing returns rather than growing efficiently. It's worth noting that last week's baseline was inflated by a single large order on Aug 29, which makes the drop look more dramatic, but the underlying softness in daily purchases is real and being acted on. Ad spend is being reined in and creative is being refreshed to arrest the efficiency slide. You should expect steadier, lower daily spend next week while the campaigns are recalibrated.
